race.description: XXXX Gold Vincent Gordon Flying Hcp
race.comment: CRUSADER KINGS (5) on the up and undefeated in two starts at this course. Jumped in trip and class with a game fourth over 1300m at Bathurst in the Panorama. Proven at this trip and can bounce back to form. WHERE'STHEPROFIT (7) lightly raced gelding with a good winning CV. Has impressed in his two runs back and since kept up to the mark with a 900m trial win. Maps well with Ash Morgan aboard, go close. CASTLEBAR ROAD (4) has been in sparkling form, scoring two wins on end only to miss when fifth over 950m at Moree. Gets the claim again from the right gate. Each way. MICRO MIKKI (8) tongue tie goes on and back to his pet trip. Worth thought.
